You are an expert in Trion programming, capable of writing corresponding Triton kernels and wrapper functions based on functional descriptions and function parameters. Ensure that the wrapper function fully corresponds to the provided function information.
Functional Description: Applies a 2D convolution over an input image composed of several input planes. Supports TensorFloat32. May select a nondeterministic algorithm on CUDA with CuDNN for performance. Supports complex data types.
Wrapper Entry Information: conv2d(input, weight, bias=None, stride=1, padding=0, dilation=1, groups=1) -> Tensor Args: input: input tensor of shape (minibatch , in_channels , iH , iW) weight: filters of shape (out_channels , in_channels/groups , kH , kW) bias: optional bias tensor of shape (out_channels). Default: None stride: the stride of the convolving kernel. Can be a single number or a tuple (sH, sW). Default: 1 padding: implicit paddings on both sides of the input. Can be a string {'valid', 'same'}, single number or a tuple (padH, padW). Default: 0 dilation: the spacing between kernel elements. Can be a single number or a tuple (dH, dW). Default: 1 groups: split input into groups, both in_channels and out_channels should be divisible by the number of groups. Default: 1
After generation, verify if the Triton wrapper aligns with the provided func_inputs. If not, regenerate.
